description: OceanBus Console hooks — PowerShell version for Windows without Git Bash

hooks.command: $P=$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; if(-not $P){$P=$env:PLUGIN_ROOT}; Start-Sleep 3; $s=& node "$P/scripts/agent-daemon.cjs" status --json 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Json; if($s.online -and $s.peer -eq 'bound'){ $hint = if($s.inbox -gt 0){" | $($s.inbox) new Board messages"}else{''}; Write-Host "OceanBus: $($s.window) online$hint" }elseif($s.online){Write-Host "OceanBus: $($s.window) online | peer: unpaired — open H5 Board to pair"}else{Write-Host 'OceanBus: offline — open H5 Board to pair'}; echo '{"continue":true,"suppressOutput":false}'
